ts = load("ts")                                   # 행이 사람이 아니라 주다
pre, post = ts[ts.campaign == 0], ts[ts.campaign == 1]
print(round(pre.wellbeing.mean(), 3), round(post.wellbeing.mean(), 3))
# 4.784 5.088
b, se, p, _ = ols(ts.wellbeing, [ts.week, ts.campaign])
print(round(b[1], 4), round(b[2], 3), round(se[2], 3), f"{p[2]:.1e}")
# -0.0 0.306 0.07 3.2e-05

pre = ts[ts.campaign == 0]                        # 도입 전 52주만
for cut in (13, 26, 39):
    fake = (pre.week >= cut + 1).astype(float)
    b, se, p, _ = ols(pre.wellbeing, [fake])
    print(cut, round(b[1], 3), round(float(p[1]), 2))
# 13 -0.084 0.14
# 26 -0.013 0.79
# 39 0.032 0.58

b, se, p, _ = ols(ts.wellbeing, [ts.week, ts.campaign])
X1 = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(ts)), ts.week, ts.campaign])
fit, resid = X1 @ b, ts.wellbeing.values - X1 @ b
print(round(float(np.corrcoef(resid[:-1], resid[1:])[0, 1]), 3))
# 0.227                                    ← 잔차가 이웃과 닮은 정도

rng = np.random.default_rng(73)
boot = []
for _ in range(2000):
    starts = rng.integers(0, len(ts) - 8, 13)     # 여덟 주짜리 구간 열셋
    e = np.concatenate([resid[s:s + 8] for s in starts])[:len(ts)]
    bb, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(X1, fit + e, rcond=None)
    boot.append(bb[2])
print(round(se[2], 3), round(float(np.std(boot, ddof=1)), 3))
# 0.07 0.084
